C-ADD-KEYBOARD-NAV.Summary: Add keyboard navigation to the ledger table (arrow keys, Home/End).
C-ADD-KEYBOARD-NAV.Problem: Keyboard users cannot move focus between ledger rows without a mouse.

Goals.Goal: Arrow keys move focus between rows; Home/End jump to first/last row.

Constraints.Constraint: Ceremony tier T1 (module change): full spec+plan, single UI package.
Use design tokens from design-system.xml; no hard-coded accent colors.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-KEYBOARD-NAV: Arrow keys move focus between rows; Home/End jump to first/last visible row.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-AXE-CLEAN: axe reports zero serious or critical violations on the ledger route.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Keyboard scenario tests pass; AccessibilityCheck remains green.

Assumptions.Assumption: Focus ring styles already honor DT-COLOR-ACCENT.
